title: Letter from Junior Sister
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji收起笑容，looked at the distance, his eyes flashing a trace of gravity: "What must come will come, I just didn't expect it so soon." The emissary from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion - fortune or misfortune?

text.content: Ling Yuan's狼狈 fleeing figure disappeared into the night, Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back in the courtyard, a faint smile playing at the corner of his lips. The night wind stirred his robes, yet could not disperse the unfathomable darkness in his eyes. "You let him go, wanting his fear to spread throughout the entire martial world?" Ye Qing's voice came from the shadows, carrying a playful tone. Chen Ji didn't turn around, simply saying calmly: "Fear, sometimes is more useful than blade and sword." He paused, "Besides, I still have a 'surprise' to give him."

Ye Qing wanted to pursue the questioning, but Chen Ji had already turned to walk toward the house. Just then, a snow-white spirit bird flapped its wings flying into the courtyard, landing on Chen Ji's shoulder, its small claws clutching a yellowed letter. "Hmm?" Chen Ji slightly raised his brow, reaching out to take the letter, "This spirit bird... is from Mo Xiansheng's side." Ye Qing came closer, watching with great interest. Su Qingyao also emerged from the shadows, her gaze falling on the letter. The three each harbored different thoughts, yet all were curious what this letter contained.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opened the envelope, unfolded the letter, and glanced at its contents. In the next second, on his eternally composed face, a rare expression of being caught between laughter and tears appeared.
Seeing Chen Ji's strange expression, Su Qingyao couldn't help but lean closer: "What does it say?"

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, handing the letter to Su Qingyao. The handwriting on the paper was elegant yet carried a fierce edge, beginning with: "Dear Brother Chen Ji: It is heard that you unfortunately perished in the Ancient Forbidden Land three months ago, the entire sect mourns in grief, and Junior Sister Qingyao wept profusely..." When Su Qingyao read到这里, her cheeks flushed slightly, shooting Chen Ji a fierce glare. Chen Ji innocently shrugged, gesturing for her to continue reading.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao cleared her throat, continuing to read: "Yet the heavens are fickle, since Brother has ascended to immortality, Junior Sister Qingyao's talent is mediocre, unfit for great responsibilities. Within Mo Xiansheng's lineage, only I, Liu Ruyan, possess some天赋, capable of inheriting the true传 of the Tianji Record. If Brother rests peacefully below, I humbly request you entrust the Tianji Record Fragment to me, so your遗志 may continue..." Reading到这里, Su Qingyao's voice already carried a hint of grinding teeth.

Ye Qing couldn't hold back any longer, bursting out laughing: "This Junior Sister Liu Ruyan must be dreaming, never expecting her 'deceased' Brother to see this letter." She teased, looking at Chen Ji, "Your废物人设, even fooled your own Junior Sister?"

Chen Ji shook his head, calmly taking a wolf-hair brush from his sleeve, writing several lines on the back of the letter. Su Qingyao and Ye Qing curiously leaned in to look,，只见他写道: "I appreciate Junior Sister Ruyan's concern, this poor Daoist feels deeply honored. Only, the grass on my tomb has not yet grown, thus it is inconvenient to report to the underworld at this time. Regarding the Tianji Record matter, Junior Sister may come to Tianqing Sect to discuss with me in person."
After Su Qingyao finished reading, she nearly spat out her tea: "The grass on my tomb has not yet grown... are you serious?"

Chen Ji folded the written reply, stuffed it back into the bamboo tube on the spirit bird's leg, patted its head for it to fly away, then said leisurely: "Junior Sister Ruyan's goodwill, how could I bear to disappoint? Besides..." A mischievous glint闪过 in his eyes, "Letting her see firsthand how this '废物' lives, would also benefit her cultivation."
Ye Qing shook her head, sighing: "I never expected your literary造诣, all used for气人." She paused, "But that Lady Liu probably never imagined, her口中的'死人', not only alive, but还能把她气得七窍生烟."

choice.prompt: In this relaxed atmosphere, Chen Ji received an urgent transmission jade slip. He crushed the jade slip, Chen Ming's voice urgent响起:

choices.description: Display the calmness of someone who has seen great场面, as if even if the sky collapses it would only be so
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao Affection +1, Display Protagonist's气度

dialogue.content: Chen Ji expressionlessly crushed the jade slip, Chen Ming's voice传来: "Young Master, the emissary from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion arrives at Tianqing Sect in three days, in name to 'inspect the Tianji Record inheritance', but in reality..." The communication cut off, clearly indicating urgent circumstances.

text.content: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, both seeing gravity in each other's eyes. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion - that was a mysterious force towering above the Three Great Sects, their emissary coming personally was绝非好事. Chen Ji only smiled faintly, putting away the jade slip fragments: "Three days? Perfect timing."

choices.description: Deliberately perform a 'sky is falling' drama in front of the two, to see their reactions
choices.visible_cost: Might be seen through by Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Amuse the two female protagonists, relieve tension

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly changed his expression, exaggeratedly stepping back, voice trembling: "T-the emissary from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion?!" He clutched his chest, as if greatly惊吓.
Ye Qing watched him with an expressionless face: "Your acting is really terrible."
Su Qingyao couldn't help but facepalm: "Be serious, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion is not a joke."

choices.description: Put away the smile, immediately enter analysis mode, begin deducing the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's intentions
choices.visible_reward: Display the protagonist's strategic side, deduce more hidden information

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's smile instantly vanished, a sharp gleam flashing in his eyes. Holding the jade slip fragments, he said calmly: "The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion sending someone now is绝非偶然. Either Ling Yuan is pushing from behind, or..." He paused, "They have already sensed the abnormality of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Ye Qing and Su Qingyao's expressions both turned grave. Chen Ji gazed into the distance, his眼神深邃: "What must come will come, I just didn't expect it so soon."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing first broke the silence: "The emissary from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion... how do you plan to handle this?" Her tone was rarely serious, clearly aware of the seriousness of this matter. Chen Ji, however, didn't answer directly, instead turning to look at Su Qingyao: "Senior Sister Su, do you have people you trust within the sect?"

Su Qingyao pondered for a moment: "There are several clever ones among the Outer Disciples, I can arrange them into the emissary reception team." She paused, "However, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's emissary is no ordinary guest, it would be very difficult to do anything during the reception process."

Chen Ji nodded, the corner of his lips lifting in a faint smile: "No need to do anything. We only need to do one thing - let them see what we want them to see." He stood with hands clasped behind his back, moonlight falling upon him, casting a slender silhouette, "A good show, is about to begin."

Watching Chen Ji's profile, Ye Qing suddenly let out a light laugh: "Sometimes I really怀疑, whether you're a废物 or a monster." She paused, "But..." She walked to Chen Ji's side, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, "Since I've chosen to cooperate, I自然陪你唱完这出戏."

Watching this scene, an inexplicable complex emotion surged in Su Qingyao's heart. She stepped forward, standing on Chen Ji's other side: "I am a disciple of Tianqing Sect, this matter naturally concerns me." She looked at Chen Ji, "Besides..." Her voice lowered slightly, "I still owe you a favor未还."

text.content: Night wind brushed past the courtyard, the three stood side by side, moonlight like water. The shadow of Ling Yuan's狼狈 fleeing three days ago seemed to have faded away, replaced by a subtle camaraderie and trust. Yet beneath this tranquility, a greater storm was brewing. The emissary from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion - coming with goodwill or with ulterior motives? Chen Ji gazed at the distant night sky, a deep meaning flickering in his eyes: "Three days is enough time for me to do many things." He turned to look at the two, "Let's go, rest well tonight. Starting tomorrow..." The corner of his lips slightly lifted, "We shall prepare a grand gift for the honored guests from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion."

Chen Ji收起笑容, looked at the distance, eyes flashing a trace of gravity. The spirit bird had vanished into the night sky, tranquility returned to the courtyard, yet everyone knew this silence was merely the calm before the storm. The emissary from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion arriving - what did this mean? It meant Chen Ji's peaceful废物 life was about to be shattered, it meant the secrets of the Tianji Record might no longer be concealed, it meant... an unprecedented game of chess was about to commence.

"What must come will come, I just didn't expect it so soon." Chen Ji murmured, his voice betraying neither joy nor anger. His gaze was profound as an abyss, as if he had already glimpsed the approaching storm. Ye Qing and Su Qingyao stood behind him, silent, yet determination gleamed in their eyes - no matter the difficulties ahead, they would fight side by side with this man. This night, sleep was destined for none. And the arrival of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's emissary three days hence would become the opening of this grand play.
